test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: 28 buckets of water are required to fill a tank. If the capacity of the bucket is reduced to two-fifth of its present capacity, then how many buckets will be required to fill the same tank completely?
solution:
Let the capacity of Bucket = x.

Then, the capacity of the tank = 28 x

New capacity of the bucket

= 2 over 5x

Then, buckets will be required to fill the same tank completely

28x × 5 over 2x

= 140 over 2

= 70

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
